verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a support-site heading saying Recruitee lets you schedule events and sync your work calendar, which is a precondition for interviewer prep rather than the prep itself. Nothing shows invites carrying an interview kit or scorecard, or automated reminders to submit feedback. Missing for 10: interview kits attached to calendar invites, scorecards linked from invites, automated feedback-submission reminders, in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration of the scheduling flow.
